authored_explainer.title: Cereal Production Is 1.5x Higher Than In 1972
authored_explainer.hook: Cereal production is 1.5x higher, defying the 1970s shortage forecasts.
says: Secondary-school progression rose from 77.8% in 1985 to 91.3% in 2017 — 1.2 times higher, meaning more students advanced.
Cereal production climbed from 1083.7 million metric tons in 1972 to 1644.1 million metric tons in 2024 — 1.5 times higher.
China has 5.2 million square kilometers of farmland; United States 4.2, Australia 3.6, Brazil 2.4, and Russia 2.2.
authored_explainer.closing: Food output kept rising, but farmland remains concentrated in a few countries.
authored_explainer.question: Which number changed your view?

authored_explainer.title: Combustible Renewables And Waste Is 3.0x Higher Than In 1990
authored_explainer.hook: Combustible renewables and waste is 3.0x higher than in 1990.
says: Combustible renewables and waste rose from 10.2% in 1990 to 30.1% in 2024 — 3.0 times higher, reshaping the energy mix.
Access to electricity grew from 73.2% in 1998 to 91.9% in 2024 — 1.3 times higher, expanding reliable power.
Methane (CH4) emissions from waste rose from 903.8 Mt CO2e in 1972 to 1,652 Mt CO2e in 2024 — 1.8 times higher.
authored_explainer.closing: Waste can supply energy, but its rising methane emissions still affect the climate you live in.
authored_explainer.question: Which tradeoff surprised you most?

authored_explainer.title: Population Growth Fell 54% Since 1972
authored_explainer.hook: Population growth fell 54% since 1972, reversing runaway-growth fears.
says: Rural population fell from 63.1% in 1972 to 42.2% in 2025 — down to 67 percent of that as cities expanded.
Population in the largest city shifted from 18.2% in 1972 to 16.2% in 2025 — it barely moved.
Population growth fell from 2 annual % in 1972 to 0.91 annual % in 2025 — down to 46 percent of that.
authored_explainer.closing: Slower growth changes future demand for schools, housing, workers, and care.
authored_explainer.question: Which shift surprised you most?
